snippet.title: SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance | Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the free demo now! Experience an enhanced version of the first stage, Oboro Village. Master the way of the shinobi, execute the ninja arts with precision, and journey through a stylized world. Enjoy a thrilling challenge with enhanced ninja abilities, greater enemy variety, unlocked hidden trial and a modified shop system. Once you've conquered the stage, push your skills further by replaying it in Arcade Mode and aim for the highest score. Play for free on PS4/PS5, Xbox, Steam and Nintendo Switch. SHINOBI Art of Vengeance releases August 29.

https://bit.ly/ShinobiAOV
